name: sin-flow
description: Ticket-to-PR flow for a live codebase: setup, sync, ingest, plan, exec, review and learning stages with their agents, hooks and CLIs.

chat_language.title: Chat language
chat_language.description: Language of the chat, for example en or uk. Empty: the language you write in. Files, commits, PRs and issues stay English.

handoff.title: Hand-off
handoff.description: How a stage starts the next one: auto, same-session, print, tmux, cmux, iterm, ghostty, warp, orca, or a path to your own script.

learning_dir.title: Learning folder
learning_dir.description: Where /sin-flow:learning keeps digests, inbox and ledger.

learning_runs.title: Learning runs
learning_runs.description: How many undigested exec runs start a learning session when an exec session ends. 0: never launch.

learning_cwd.title: Learning start folder
learning_cwd.description: Where that learning session starts. Empty: the learning folder.

merge.title: Merge method
merge.description: Merge method for your own PRs.

after_review.title: Review fixes
after_review.description: How review fixes land on an open PR. new-commit: a new commit on top.

branch_prefix.title: Branch prefix
branch_prefix.description: First segment of the branch <prefix>/<type>/<id>/<slug>. Empty: no segment.

context_guard.title: Context guard
context_guard.description: Percent of the 1M-token context window at which a flow stage hands off or stops. CTX_GUARD_THRESHOLD overrides it for one session.

limit_guard.title: Limit guard
limit_guard.description: on: warn a flow session near the 5-hour or 7-day limit, from the state file of the status line wrapper. off: only the Claude Code auto-continue.

models_strong.title: Strong model
models_strong.description: Plan, exec and learning sessions, every hand-off, the review lenses on the strong tier.

models_mid.title: Mid model
models_mid.description: Read-only analysts, implementers, shipper, review-poster, the review lenses on the mid tier.

codex_review.title: Codex review
codex_review.description: on: the exec review also runs OpenAI Codex CLI as one more finder. Needs codex installed and codex login.

codex_model_pr.title: Codex model for PR review
codex_model_pr.description: A Codex model family or a full model name. /sin-flow:review of a teammate's PR then also runs Codex on it. Empty: no Codex in pr mode.

codex_watch.title: Codex watch
codex_watch.description: orca: the Orca workspace card shows each step of a Codex run. Empty: off.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Where sin-flow-worktree makes the worktree of each stage. orca also turns on the Stop hook that marks the Orca worktree read.

work_remote.title: Work notes remote
work_remote.description: A git remote for ~/.claude/sin-flow (work notes and profiles). Empty: local only.

opensource_dir.title: Open-source folder
opensource_dir.description: Where /sin-flow:setup clones a repo of another owner that you change through your fork.

notes_globs.title: Note globs
notes_globs.description: Space-separated globs of agent notes in every repo. The shipper never stages a match. Empty: only the symlink and hash checks against the work folder and the profile key notes.paths.
